snippet.title: Hollow Home | Release Date Trailer
snippet.description:
Hollow Home releases on January 27, 2027.
Wishlist on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2362070/Hollow_Home/?utm_source=youtube&utm_campaign=release_trailer

Hollow Home is a narrative survival RPG about Maksym, a 14-year-old boy alone in a city under siege. With no weapons and no battles, he has to survive through the people he meets and the choices he makes.

Play the free demo: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3142360/Hollow_Home_Demo/

Developed by Twigames in Kyiv, Ukraine. Published by Crunchy Leaf Games.

Music: "Dusha" by Renie Cares
